## Owner direction and the bound used here

The owner stated:

> Okay, let's take a bounded journey down this path. If we demonstrate something,
> great. If not, let's go back to basics and see if we can define a scientific
> contract with what we have. Feel free to push back if it's needed.

This authorizes the present synthesis and feasibility inspection and preparation
of a concrete return-to-contract option. It is not approval of the proposed
EL-F14 method or a new reduction, intervention, population or Stage B dispatch.

The review is limited to the existing repository evidence and one metadata
inventory of seven retained EL-F12 H/uninjected PTC diagnostic files and seven
restart checkpoints, covering iterations 0–6. It asks whether an additional
benefit experiment can be justified from the actual pipeline. It performs no
new score, source fit, synthetic trial, replay or observation search.

A follow-up experiment would need a specific unresolved physical quantity,
an available measurement or justified truth/null construction, and outcomes
that change a scientific decision. A result that merely motivates another
proxy is insufficient. This review stops after the inventory and synthesis;
it does not automatically initiate another EL-F experiment.

## What the existing work has established

| Evidence | Retained value | Limit on the conclusion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Historical recurrence recovery, restart repair and later control identity gates | Reliable comparison and restart on the tested paths; complete-product semantics recovered | Exact f70701ad executable equivalence and universal implementation conformity remain unavailable |
| Compact-source development and EL-F7 history decomposition | Feedback can build compact response over iterations; earlier state can also cancel current-step structure | One bright source/profile is not a calibrated, generic transfer function; history contains more than the sky model |
| Faster accumulation, simple stopping and broad feedback bypass screens | Specific shortcuts rejected under their declared protections | No claim that every possible alternative fails |
| EL-F10/EL-F11 | Exact signed JINC explanation and strong oracle-targeted temporal persistence for the diagnosed exclusion | UID 4460 diagnosis remains closed; response size/persistence does not establish benefit |
| EL-F12 | Half and Hold not_promising, each 23 failed protections of 315; historical audit controls reproduce the baseline | Neither candidate advances; some endpoint failures are shared with H; the unattainable leakage improvement is a screen limitation |
| EL-F13 | Exact historical reconstruction; three probes unavailable from support loss and the one available probe worsens agreement | Primary negative challenge unassessed, no positive empirical benefit evidence, shared references can share contamination |

These results have diagnostic and engineering value. They do not demonstrate
a superior recurrence or policy. H is the mandatory scientific control, not
sky truth or a promise that every absolute endpoint passes. Different
iterations, arrays and injections within one observation are not independent
pointing replications.

## The one remaining measurement considered

The strongest remaining candidate was a **fully matched-operator response**
measurement: apply the same realized processing operator to data with and
without a known added source. This would distinguish conditional source
response from changes caused by relearning the processing.

That distinction is already stated in the approved-use
[response measurement frame](EL_RESPONSE_MEASUREMENT_FRAME_R0.1.md) and the
[EL-F7 result](../../../../../../validation/fruit_loop_point_123424_el_f7_shared_start_response_2026-09-03/EXECUTION_RESULT_R0.1.md).
EL-F7 demonstrated that equal incoming checkpoints and equal later persisted
learning state do not establish equality of all within-iteration operators.

The metadata inventory verified all 14 original file identities and read
variable names, dimensions, shapes and types without decoding scientific
array values. PTC diagnostics contain per-scan detector summaries and optional
selector diagnostics, rather than a complete realized detector-loading basis
with time-local application state. The inspected checkpoints carry causal
restart state, not a certified frozen PTC application. The
[retained schema inventory](../../../../../../validation/fruit_loop_bounded_evidence_review_2026-09-06/RETAINED_OPERATOR_METADATA_R0.1.json)
records the exact scope. It does not prove that no other uninspected artifact
could help, or that raw data could never regenerate the state. Diagnostic
field presence also does not establish that an optional feature was active.

Source inspection supports the distinction: PTC computes eigenvectors during
the scan and stores them conditionally. A mode count, spectrum or detector
RMS cannot substitute for the complete operator. No replay-ready operator
binding has been demonstrated by this review.

More fundamentally, even a successful conditional response measurement would
not tell us whether a suspect contribution contains recoverable sky or
contamination in the real field. It measures the response to the declared
injection. A benefit decision still needs an appropriate sky/nuisance target
and evidence connecting the pre-action statistic to the whole changed
trajectory. A frozen operator also cannot stand in for an intervention that
changes that operator. The proposed measurement could serve a later,
specifically scoped response-validation task; it is insufficient justification
for continuing the present retention-policy search.

## Disposition

**No additional retention experiment is recommended from this bounded review.**
This is a development-planning conclusion, not an empirical proof that no
beneficial method exists. No new numerical benefit or transfer was measured.

EL-F14 r0.1 remains unapproved and unrun. Its original bytes are preserved;
the manager withdraws the recommendation to execute it. Its common-mode toy
assumption does not establish additional information beyond PTC or describe
the actual processed input. No revision, threshold adjustment or replacement
toy test is commissioned here.

The recommended next step is the accompanying scientific-core scope decision.
The existing record is sufficient to identify scientific obligations and
limiting cases, but insufficient to certify a numerical policy, generic
recovery, automatic stopping, complete covariance or an operational method.
Writing the former must not imply the latter.

## Sources adopted, cited and excluded

Adopt the accepted input bindings, separate method/claim/evidence identities,
PTC/MAP/JINC/NOI ownership, causal-state and restart distinctions, and the
standing routine-defect direction. Cite historical source recovery and all
empirical results as bounded evidence only. Reuse the independent scientific
conventions already recovered in `PRIOR_WORK.md`; do not ask an author to
rediscover them. Defer numerical parent admission, model selection, response,
stopping thresholds and qualified profiles. Supersede only the manager's
recommendation to run EL-F14; supersede no approved science or result.

Code, this review, retained outputs, schema inventory, failed candidates and
observation-specific thresholds remain outside the author channel. Future
author inputs require their own sanitized, exact manifest and owner approval.
The [review manifest](BOUNDED_REVIEW_MANIFEST_R0.1.md) binds the sources and
preservation checks. Historical control, independent-pointing replication
before policy, qualification, production and Unity boundaries remain intact.
